text: A protected field unit brings sensing, connectivity and irrigation control together close to the crop.
The soil probe enters the root zone, the DHT11 measures the crop microclimate, and protected connections carry power and the pump output.
Open the weatherproof side-hinged lid to reveal the ESP32, 5 V relay, soil-sensor interface, protected terminals and routed wiring.
The soil probe and DHT11 measure field conditions. The ESP32 reads those sensors and reports their measurements to the AgroFlow platform.
Irrigation decisions are sent to the field controller, which uses its relay module to switch the connected pump output.
From field conditions to irrigation action.
One connected unit closes the loop between the crop zone, the AgroFlow platform and controlled watering.
